$comment: Single source of truth for the dashboard tiles AND discover.mjs. Each tool declares its integration TYPE (how a person sets it up) and a VALIDATE spec (how Claude earns a confidence level 0-3). No secrets and no machine paths here; keys are referenced by NAME only. discover.mjs reads each keyVar from process.env, or from a gitignored discovery/sources.local.json that maps a key name to the .env file currently holding it (the spit-and-glue we're cleaning up). North star: centralise keys so sources.local.json isn't needed.

types.connector: Account-level OAuth (claude.ai connector). Authorize once at claude.ai/customize/connectors; no local install; follows the account.
types.local-mcp: Local MCP server (stdio) installed on this machine; reads an API key from env/.env; needs per-tool permission.
types.cli: Standalone CLI tool authenticated in its own config (gh, wrangler).

categories.title: Build & ship your site
categories.blurb: The loop: your words → a private vault → live on the web → feedback → the next version.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.desc: The Vault. Every version of your site kept private — your time machine and your undo button.

setup.how: Install GitHub CLI and run `gh auth login`.

tools.name: Cloudflare
tools.desc: The Publisher & doorman. Puts your site online, guards it with logins, and can sell you a web address.

setup.how: Run `wrangler login`, or set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to a valid token.

tools.name: Linear
tools.desc: The Inbox. The feedback button on your site files tickets here; Claude reads them and ships the fixes.

setup.how: Authorize the Linear connector at claude.ai/customize/connectors.

categories.title: Image generation
categories.blurb: Make any picture from words — including believable ones of you.

tools.name: ChatGPT · DALL·E
tools.desc: OpenAI's image models. Strong at stylised art and following long, detailed prompts — a dependable all-rounder.

setup.how: Put a valid OPENAI_API_KEY in the image MCP's .env (mcp-universal-images).

tools.name: Google Gemini · nano-banana
tools.desc: Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (“nano-banana”). Best at keeping a face consistent across scenes and editing by plain instruction — the reason portraits of you look like you. Fast, cheap, blends reference photos cleanly.

setup.how: Put a valid GEMINI_API_KEY in the image MCP's .env (mcp-universal-images).

categories.title: Real images
categories.blurb: When you want a genuine photograph, not something generated.

tools.name: Google Image Search
tools.desc: Pulls real photos from the web's libraries — authentic stock, products, places and reference shots. Use when “real” matters more than “bespoke”.

setup.how: Install the google-search MCP (`claude mcp add`).

categories.title: Sound & music
categories.blurb: Give the site a voice and a soundtrack.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.desc: Lifelike AI voices and narration — turn text into natural speech for intros, walkthroughs and accessibility.

setup.how: Get an ElevenLabs API key, set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, install the ElevenLabs MCP.

tools.name: Google Lyria · MusicFX
tools.desc: Google's Lyria music models (the engine behind MusicFX) generate royalty-free music and soundscapes from a text prompt — via the Google AI API (models/lyria-3-*).

setup.how: Use a Google AI key (GEMINI_API_KEY) with Lyria access; call a models/lyria-3-* model.
